```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
#loading packages
library('dplyr')
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(jtools)
library('interactions')
library(ltm)
library(car)
library(MBESS)

#loading data
BR <- read.csv("~/Study 1 Data.csv")

```

#Key Variable Names
 * IS = Incentive Salience manipulation condition (1 = high, -1 = low)
 * Charity = Prosocial Motivation manipulation condition (1 = high, -1 = low)
 * ISMC = Incentive Salience manipulation check (7-point scale)
 * PMMC = Prosocial Motivation manipulation check (7-point scale)
 * DV_likely = Donation likelihood (7-point scale)

#Demographic
```{r}
#Gender and age
BR$gender <- factor(BR$gender)
levels(BR$gender) <- c('female', 'non-binary', 'male')
BR  %>% count(gender)
describe(BR[, c("age", "PMMC")], range=TRUE)
```

#Manpulation check
```{r}
#Incentive salience
t.test(ISMC ~ IS, data=BR, var.equal=TRUE)
tapply(BR$ISMC,BR$IS,sd) #SD
BR  %>% count(IS)
ci.smd(ncp= 4.3847, n.1=399, n.2=409, conf.level=.95) #ISMC

#One-sample for IS: all above the midpoint
with(BR%>%filter(IS==1), t.test(ISMC, mu=4))
with(BR%>%filter(IS==-1), t.test(ISMC, mu=4))

#Low IS condition's median
BR.low <- BR%>%filter(IS==-1)
median(BR.low$ISMC)

#Charity manipulation
t.test(PMMC ~ Charity, data=BR, var.equal=TRUE)
tapply(BR$PMMC,BR$Charity,sd) #SD
BR  %>% count(Charity)
ci.smd(ncp= 10.63, n.1=405, n.2=403, conf.level=.95) #CharityMC

#Reliability for Charity MC
PMMC <- as.data.frame(cbind(BR$PMMC_1,BR$PMMC_2,BR$PMMC_3))
cronbach.alpha(PMMC, CI=FALSE)

#Checking for a crossover effect (R1)
t.test(PMMC ~ IS, data=BR, var.equal=TRUE)
tapply(BR$PMMC,BR$IS,sd) #SD
ci.smd(ncp= 1.1168, n.1=399, n.2=409, conf.level=.95) 

t.test(ISMC ~ Charity, data=BR, var.equal=TRUE)
tapply(BR$ISMC,BR$Charity,sd) #SD
ci.smd(ncp= 1.641, n.1=405, n.2=403, conf.level=.95)
```
# Donation Likelihood DV
```{r}
m1 = glm(DV_likely ~ IS*Charity, data=BR)
summ(m1, digit=4)
sim_slopes(m1, pred=IS, modx = Charity, digits = 5)
```
Means and SDs
```{r}
Means.Table<-BR %>%
  group_by(Charity, IS) %>%
  summarise(N=n(),
            Means=mean(DV_likely),
            SD=sd(DV_likely),
            SE=SD/N^.5)
print(Means.Table)
```
Graph
```{r}
BR %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Charity, y = DV_likely, color = factor(IS))) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "", x = "PM", color = "Inc Salience")
```
